summary: The page is well encoded. All six diagnoses are correct probable rules, and the red-box Urgent rule covers every representable criterion with matching check items. The most consequential gap is footnote 1's shock definition (pulse >= 100, RR > 30, restlessness, weakness), which is not encoded, so the shock criterion depends on 'Shock' being recorded directly. The Hb criterion and the review-time lab referral thresholds are not representable. The tinea versicolor neck/upper-arm sites and the hepatitis A IgM-positive diagnosis are minor omissions.
